NDINA Studio

The Studio

NDINA operates a working artist studio at the top of Cakobau Hill, just 5 minutes' walk from the Fiji Museum and 15 minutes from Suva city centre. During the day the studio provides an ideal space for quiet creative practice, empowering Fijian artists with a small but essential oasis for expression and experimentation.

The Studio also hosts a regular program of art classes (beginner to advanced), workshops and occasional open-air exhibitions in the ample garden. Activity details are updated on our Luma page regularly.

Resident Artist Josaia Waqabaca McNamara welcomes studio visits weekly from Tuesday – Thursday, between the hours of 9am–3pm.
